description: The signed-in person's teams: key (teamKey), name, and the facts the system derives rather than stores (members = confirmed people; rate = blended from members' rates unless the team sets an override; languages from members unless set); each team's profile (based, remote, availability, shipped work), open and matching brief counts, and a checklist of what pitching and the public board require, each marked met or missing.
name: read_my_teams
title: My teams
